lines.fn1: A scene is a pure function of time. Give it a moment, and it draws exactly that picture.
lines.fn2: Canvas, S V G, or C S S, it does not matter. Nothing depends on a real clock.
lines.br1: The renderer opens the page in headless Chromium, and waits until fonts and assets are ready.
lines.br2: Then, for every frame, it calls set time, and takes a screenshot.
lines.ff1: Several browser pages render in parallel, and the frames are put back in order.
lines.ff2: They are piped into F F M peg, which encodes them as an H dot two six four video.
lines.au1: The narration is made separately: text becomes speech, one audio clip for each line.
lines.au2: Each clip's duration is saved, and the scene uses it to time its captions.
lines.mx1: F F M peg delays every clip to its start time, and mixes them into a single audio track.
lines.mx2: Video and audio are then combined into one M P 4 file, ready for the website.
lines.outro: A function of time, sampled frame by frame, mixed with narration. That is how a web animation becomes a video with sound.
